| int simpleIf(int a)
  alternative
    | a > 0
    -
      instruction
        | a = 1;
    -
  jump
    | return a

  alternative
    | a > 0
    -
      instruction
        | a = 1;
    -
      instruction
        | a = -1;
  jump
    | return a

== Branches.elseIfChain (line 18)
| String elseIfChain(int a)
  alternative
    | a < 0
    -
      jump
        | return "negative"
    -
      alternative
        | a == 0
        -
          jump
            | return "zero"
        -
          alternative
            | a < 10
            -
              jump
                | return "small"
            -
              jump
                | return "large"

  alternative
    | a > 0
    -
      alternative
        | b > 0
        -
          jump

        -
      jump
        | return 2
    -
  jump
    | return 3

| boolean logic(int a, int b)
  alternative
    | a > 0 && b > 0 || a < -10
    -
      jump
        | return true
    -
  jump
    | return false

== Branches.ternary (line 47)
| int ternary(int a)
  instruction
    | int b = a > 0 ? a : -a;
  jump
    | return b
